$schema-note: EnterpriseOps health-check contract. Read once at startup by HealthProbeService; served by GET /healthz (readiness) and GET /healthz/live (liveness). Never served as a static file.

checks.name: configuration
checks.description: startup validation passed for the active environment

checks.name: database
checks.description: a known query returns rows (work orders for the probe tenant)

checks.name: websocket
checks.description: the WebSocket transport is available through the proxy

checks.name: sessionStore
checks.description: the in-memory session store accepts sessions (count below the node limit)

checks.name: theme
checks.description: the default theme named in Default.json / Web.config is resolvable

notes: Readiness fails (503) when any critical check fails; the balancer stops sending NEW sessions to the node.
Liveness never inspects dependencies: it answers 200 while the process can run code, so an orchestrator restarts only truly dead nodes.
Existing sessions on a node that turns unhealthy are drained: the node keeps answering pinned sessions until sessionTimeout, then leaves the pool.
